Name: AIESEC US Joins the Global GivingTuesday Movement to Empower Tomorrow’s Leaders
Post Summary: [New York, October 26, 2023] – AIESEC United States, the largest youth-run non-profit organization dedicated to empowering young leaders through transformative international experiences, is thrilled to announce its participation in GivingTuesday, a global generosity movement that harnesses the collective power of individuals, communities, and organizations to encourage radical generosity and make a lasting impact.
Post Body:
[New York, October 26, 2023] – AIESEC United States, the largest youth-run non-profit organization dedicated to empowering young leaders through transformative international experiences, is thrilled to announce its participation in GivingTuesday, a global generosity movement that harnesses the collective power of individuals, communities, and organizations to encourage radical generosity and make a lasting impact.

GivingTuesday, initiated in 2012, has evolved into a year-round global movement inspiring millions to come together to give, share, and celebrate the spirit of generosity. It serves as a reminder that every act of kindness, no matter how small, contributes to building a more inclusive, compassionate, and vibrant world.

This year, AIESEC US is proud to align its efforts with Giving Tuesday, further amplifying its mission of fostering skills development through practical experiences and cross-cultural understanding among young individuals. AIESEC US aims to create positive change and empower young minds to be catalysts for a brighter future through its various initiatives, including the ongoing fundraising campaign for Educational Equity.

About the AIESEC US fundraising campaign

In a world where access to quality education and life-changing experiences is unevenly distributed, AIESEC US is committed to fostering educational equity and sustainable development. Many talented and ambitious young individuals from underrepresented backgrounds face financial constraints that hinder their pursuit of personal growth and international experiences.

The fundraising campaign aims to address this disparity and empower these young minds to reach their full potential. By offering scholarships for the AIESEC Global Volunteer Exchange program, AIESEC US seeks to provide a pathway for at least 15 students to engage in community development projects aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.

"At AIESEC US, we believe in the transformative power of youth and their ability to drive meaningful change in the world," said Abby Lemma, President and CEO of AIESEC US. "Joining GivingTuesday amplifies our commitment to shaping young leaders who are not only empathetic and globally aware but are also actively engaged in making a positive impact."

By joining the GivingTuesday movement, AIESEC US invites supporters to take meaningful action and play a vital role in empowering young individuals and creating a more inclusive world.

"We invite everyone to join us on this journey of generosity and impact," Soraya Morales added. "Your support can make a significant difference, whether donating to our campaign or spreading the message. Together, we can inspire a wave of transformation and create a brighter future for all."

This GivingTuesday, let's unite as a global community to celebrate generosity, uplift underserved communities, and empower young leaders to be the change-makers of tomorrow. To learn more about AIESEC US's participation in GivingTuesday and to contribute to our campaign, please visit www.aiesecus.org/donate. Join the movement and be a part of the change. Together, we can make a difference.

#GivingTuesday #EmpowerYoungPeople #Leadership

About AIESEC US

AIESEC US, founded in 1948, is a youth-led non-profit organization that provides young people with opportunities for personal and professional development through international experiences, such as internships and volunteering programs. Run entirely by youth, AIESEC US is committed to fostering cross-cultural understanding, leadership development, and global citizenship among young individuals.

Name: AIESEC US Joins the Interact Club of Chinatown NYC to Empower Youth Through the 5K Red Run
Post Summary: AIESEC in the United States partnered with the Interact Club of Chinatown NYC for the 5K Red Run, promoting youth leadership, community engagement, and the SDGs.
Post Body:
AIESEC US Joins the Interact Club of Chinatown NYC to Empower Youth Through the 5K Red Run

At AIESEC in the United States, we believe that leadership starts with taking action, and that impact begins when young people come together for a cause greater than themselves.

Earlier this fall, AIESEC partnered with the Interact Club of Chinatown NYC, part of the Rotary Club of Chinatown, to support their 5K Red Run, a community initiative designed to promote youth engagement, global citizenship, and awareness around meaningful causes.

Running for Purpose

The 5K Red Run brought together more than 20 young participants and community members in New York City, each contributing their energy and enthusiasm to make a positive difference. AIESEC US proudly joined as a sponsor and participant, reinforcing our commitment to advancing the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through local and global action.

Our members not only supported the event but also joined the run itself, embodying the AIESEC spirit of leadership through experience. From start to finish, the event reflected what collaboration between purpose-driven organizations can achieve when aligned around a shared mission: developing young leaders for a better world.

Empowering Youth Leadership

This collaboration with the Interact Club highlighted the importance of empowering youth-led organizations to connect, share experiences, and amplify their impact. By combining Rotary’s strong tradition of community service with AIESEC’s global network of young leaders, the partnership showcased the power of intergenerational cooperation to drive progress toward the SDGs.

“Moments like this remind us that leadership is not just about words, it’s about showing up, taking part, and inspiring others to do the same,”
said Yokelvy Vargas Prud-Home, Head of External Relations & Incoming Global Talent at AIESEC in the United States.

Moving Forward

The success of the 5K Red Run represents just the beginning of this partnership. Both AIESEC and the Interact Club of Chinatown plan to continue exploring opportunities to collaborate on future initiatives that foster leadership, cross-cultural understanding, and positive community impact.

Together, we are building bridges between youth organizations to create a more sustainable and connected world — one step, one run, and one partnership at a time.

About AIESEC in the United States

AIESEC is the world’s largest youth-led organization, activating leadership through cross-cultural exchanges and professional experiences since 1948. Learn more about how we empower young people to make a difference at www.aiesecus.org.

Name: Empower Tomorrow's Leaders: Your Global Opportunity Awaits
Post Summary: Are you a young person passionate about leadership, cultural exchange, and making a positive impact on your community? The Empower Tomorrow's Leaders scholarship is your gateway to an incredible global experience. Apply now for a chance to join the AIESEC Global Volunteer Program and transform your aspirations into action.
Post Body:
Are you a young person passionate about leadership, cultural exchange, and making a positive impact on your community? The Empower Tomorrow's Leaders scholarship is your gateway to an incredible global experience. Apply now for a chance to join the AIESEC Global Volunteer Program and transform your aspirations into action.

Why Apply?

The Empower Tomorrow's Leaders campaign is specifically designed to support young individuals who are eager to make a difference. This scholarship provides unparalleled opportunities for leadership development, cross-cultural immersion, and community impact. Open to U.S. citizens or permanent residents, the scholarship ensures that financial constraints do not stand in the way of your global ambitions.

What’s Included?

Thanks to the generosity of individual donors, we have secured funds to cover all expenses related to your participation in the AIESEC Global Volunteer Program. Here's what the scholarship covers:

- Full Program Fee: $700
- Round-Trip Airfare: Up to $700
- Accommodation
- Health Insurance
- Weekly Stipend: $150

Program Highlights

As a participant in the AIESEC Global Volunteer Program, you will engage in:

- Community Service Projects: Contribute to one of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
- Leadership Workshops and Training: Enhance your leadership skills through specialized sessions.
- Cross-Cultural Immersion: Experience life in a different culture and gain a global perspective.
- Networking with AIESEC Peers: Build lasting connections with like-minded individuals.
- Professional and Personal Development: Grow both personally and professionally through hands-on experience.

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for the Empower Tomorrow's Leaders scholarship, you must:

- Be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
- Be between 18 and 30 years old
- Have a strong interest in leadership and community service
- Demonstrate AIESEC Values: Activating Leadership, Acting Sustainably, Striving for Excellence, Living Diversity, Enjoying Participation, and Demonstrating Integrity

Application Process

Ready to embark on this life-changing journey? Follow these steps to apply:

1. Fill Out the Online Application Form: Provide your basic information and express your motivation for applying.
2. Submit Two Letters of Recommendation: Ask mentors, teachers, or employers who can vouch for your leadership potential and community involvement.
3. Attend an Interview: If shortlisted, you will be invited for an interview to discuss your application in more detail.

Deadline to Apply: August 31, 2024 - 11:59 PM ET

Apply Now!

Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to develop your leadership skills, immerse yourself in a new culture, and make a lasting impact on the world. Apply now for the Empower Tomorrow's Leaders scholarship and take the first step towards a brighter future.

For more information and to apply, visit https://www.aiesecus.org/students/get-scholarship.

Post Body:
[New York, September 21, 2023] - AIESEC US, the largest youth-run non-profit organization dedicated to empowering young people with transformative international experiences, proudly announces the launch of a groundbreaking fundraising campaign aimed at providing educational equity through scholarships for global opportunities to young students who lack financial resources. As part of Global Goals Week, this campaign directly contributes to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, focusing on quality education, reduced inequalities, and climate action. With the mission to break down barriers and create a more inclusive educational landscape, the campaign seeks to raise funds to offer scholarships for the AIESEC Global Volunteer Exchange program.

Education Equality: Opening Doors to Global Opportunities

In a world where access to quality education and life-changing experiences is unevenly distributed, AIESEC US is committed to fostering education equality. Many talented and ambitious young individuals from underrepresented backgrounds face financial constraints that hinder their pursuit of personal growth and international experiences.

The fundraising campaign aims to address this disparity and empower these young minds to reach their full potential. By offering scholarships for the AIESEC Global Volunteer Exchange program, AIESEC US seeks to provide a pathway for at least 15 students to engage in community development projects aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.

Global Volunteer Exchange Program: Creating Impactful Change

The AIESEC Global Volunteer Exchange program presents a unique opportunity for young individuals to immerse themselves in diverse cultures while contributing to projects that promote sustainable development. Through projects focused on the SDGs #4 Quality Education, #10 Reduced Inequalities, and #13 Climate Action, participants make a positive impact on communities around the world.

Beyond the tangible contributions, these international experiences also provide invaluable personal development opportunities. Participants gain cross-cultural understanding, leadership skills, and a broader perspective on global issues, equipping them to become effective leaders and change-makers.

Supporting the Mission: Empower Dreams with Your Donation

AIESEC US invites individuals, corporations, organizations, and philanthropic foundations to join the mission of education equality and global opportunities. By contributing to the fundraising campaign, donors will directly support students' travel expenses, program fees, and resources.

"Our vision is to create a world where every student, regardless of their background, has equal access to quality education and cross-cultural experiences. With your support, we can empower these young minds to become global citizens and agents of positive change,"

said Abiseniya Lemma, CEO and President at AIESEC US.

Transparency and Impact

Transparency and accountability are fundamental values at AIESEC US. Throughout the campaign, donors will receive regular updates on the progress of the fundraising efforts, the allocation of funds, and the selection process for scholarship recipients. AIESEC US is committed to maintaining clear channels of communication, building trust, and fostering a community of stakeholders passionate about educational equity and global opportunities.

Join the Mission: Create a Transformative Journey

As the campaign takes flight during Global Goals Week, AIESEC US calls on all individuals and organizations to be part of this transformative journey. Together, we can make a lasting impact on the lives of underrepresented students, providing them with the means to access life-changing international experiences.

To donate or learn more about the fundraising campaign, visit www.aiesecus.org/donate. Join us in breaking down barriers, fostering education equality, and paving the way for a future where every young mind has the opportunity to thrive and contribute to positive change.
